verdict.rationale: Bulk operations are a fair axis for an API-driven fraud platform, for example batch order submission or bulk decision updates. However, every documented endpoint (/decide, /submit, /advise, chargeback) works on a single order, and nothing in the pack shows a batch or bulk endpoint. Automated per-order flows such as Shopify void/capture and chargeback gateway integrations are automation, not multi-item bulk actions.
